bullets.text: Risky Free VPN Surge - Users turn to free VPNs for privacy, exposing data to servers in China and Russia.
5G Mobile Core Growth - The 5G mobile core network surged 31% in Q2 2025, driven by subscriber growth.
BT Expands Cloud Partnership - BT Group signs a five-year deal with **AWS** to enhance customer-focused digital experiences.
Open RAN 5G at Stadium - **Boldyn Networks** and **VMO2** deploy Open RAN 5G at Sunderland's Stadium of Light.
Global DDoS Attacks Rise - Over 8 million DDoS attacks recorded in H1 2025, targeting major political events.
Nokia's Rail Connectivity - **Nokia** unveils a new 5G radio solution to modernize rail communications globally.
AI-RAN Trials in 5G - **KT** tests AI-driven radio access technology on its live 5G network in South Korea.
Private 5G for Offshore - **Tampnet** deploys private 5G for offshore drilling and production units in the North Sea.
